$comment: Segment vocabulary (D-16, D-27, D-69, D-74d, D-76): a definition is { name, description?, filters: [{ field, op, value? }] }, every filter ANDed, no expressions. Fields and ops are closed; an op is allowed on a field only if listed under its type. giftDate is not a member value: its one `between` filter sets the window for totalInWindow, giftCount and lastGiftDate (default: everything up to asOf). lybunt/sybunt read calendar years of asOf and ignore the window.
